80555104.title: File:2019-07-19 - Coppélia in Moscow (Bolshoi Theatre) - Sorokin.jpg

ImageDescription.value:
Ballet "Coppélia" in three acts in Bolshoi Theatre (the New Stage), the performance on July 19, 2019.
Swanilda — Margarita Shrayner
Frantz — Vyacheslav Lopatin
Coppelius — Gennadi Yanin
Friends to Swanilda — Xenia Averina, Daria Bochkova, Bruna Cantanhede Gaglianone, Antonina Chapkina, Anastasia Denisova, Elizaveta Kruteleva, Daria Lovtsova, Xenia Zhiganshina
Coppelia (Automaton) — Nadezhda Gredasova
Lord of the Manor — Alexander Fadeyechev
Burgomaster — Yuri Ostrovsky
Mazurka — Nino Asatiani, Yanina Parienko, Dmitry Efremov, Pyotr Gusev
Czardas — Anna Balukova, Anton Savichev
L'Aurore (Dawn) — Yulia Skvortsova
La Priere (Prayer) — Anastasia Denisova
Le Travail (Work) — Elizaveta Kruteleva, Xenia Averina, Stanislava Postnova, Tatiana Tiliguzova, Vlada Zakharova
La Folie (Folly) — Maria Mishina
Chronos — Nikolai Mayorov
Conductor — Pavel Sorokin

Балет "Драгоценности" в Москве, Большой Театр, 28 апреля 2024.

190639345.title: File:Exhibition view – “Inventing Anna” at ARTBOX.PROJECT Basel 2.0 (2023).jpg

ImageDescription.value: Exhibition view from ARTBOX.PROJECT Basel 2.0 (2023), featuring the neo-pop artwork Inventing Anna by Honys Torres displayed on a digital panel. The installation is located inside the EuroAirport Basel exhibition hall, with other participating artworks and event branding visible in the environment. The piece reinterprets the cultural phenomenon surrounding Anna Sorokin/Delvey through a vibrant pop-art collage filled with symbols of luxury, media spectacle, and contemporary identity performance.

Inventing Anna (2022) is a neo‑pop artwork by Honys Torres inspired by the cultural phenomenon surrounding Anna Sorokin/Delvey. The piece blends luxury iconography, media spectacle, and contemporary identity performance into a vibrant acrylic composition. With its bold color palette and layered symbolic references, the artwork reflects on fame, fraud, and the construction of public personas. Created in acrylic on canvas (130 × 130 cm), it was selected for ARTBOX.PROJECT Basel 2.0 and presented at ARTBOXEXPO Basel 2023.

190638801.title: File:Inventing Anna – Promotional Poster – ARTBOX.PROJECT Basel 2.0 (2023).jpg

ImageDescription.value: Promotional poster for ARTBOX.PROJECT Basel 2.0 (2023), featuring the neo-pop artwork Inventing Anna by Honys Torres. The piece draws inspiration from the cultural impact of the Netflix series Inventing Anna, which dramatizes the story of Anna Sorokin/Delvey and her performance of wealth, identity, and social manipulation. Torres reinterprets this figure through a vibrant pop-art collage filled with symbols of luxury, media spectacle, and digital-era mythology. The poster includes the artist’s branding, artwork title, and official exhibition details for ARTBOXEXPO Basel 2023.
